What we do

A city that doesn't listen to its people slowly loses its soul.

Streets that feel unsafe at night. Parks nobody uses. Intersections that confuse. The sense that a neighbourhood was designed for someone who doesn't live there.

City Layers gives these feelings a voice and a location. We are a transdisciplinary platform that bridges citizen science with urban planning expertise. Using our inhouse digital tool by collecting lived experience from communities and translating it into actionable place intelligence for decision-makers.

A platform co-developed with planners, architects, and engaged residents across Europe.

Funded in part by multiple European initiatives and and alligned with SDG Goals at its core.

Currently active in 3 countries.
01 / Layer

Participatory Mapping

Residents pin feelings, observations, and ideas directly onto the city. Every comment lives on the map, anchored to the place it describes. A Geo-located representation of human experience.

See it in action
02 / Layer

Place Intelligence

A methodology that combines participatory methods and digital tools in order to achieve advanced analytics by clustering signals, surfacing patterns, and revealing the urban dynamics that lie beneath the numbers.

Read the methodology
03 / Layer

Decision Support

Evidence-based decision support. Actionable case files that equip planners and architects to connect real community signals with the spatial data and policy levers that drive impact.
